facts.fact: Alfama contains cobbled lanes, steep inclines and historic buildings.
The Lisbon Cathedral dates from 1147; its treasury and earlier Roman remains are visitor features described by the tourism office.
Santa Luzia viewpoint overlooks Alfama and the Tagus.

title: Visit Lisboa — Alfama
